cherryhq-cherry-studio-agents-agent-note.description: Use when deciding whether a Cherry Studio change needs an Agent Note, authoring or reviewing a Spec, recording a durable bug-fix decision, moving a note between proposed/implemented/rejected, or checking supersession and stacked Spec approval.

cherryhq-cherry-studio-resources-builtin.description: 从当前安装包查询 Cherry Studio 产品信息并排查运行问题。当用户询问功能、路由、快捷键、Provider、语言、Agent、频道、定时任务、Code CLI、当前版本，或报告运行错误、连接失败、配置异常并需要诊断时触发。

cherryhq-cherry-studio-resources-cherry-.description: Control the user's visible Agent browser: navigate, click, type, screenshot, debug. Needs the Browser setting.
Drive native apps via Computer Use: open, inspect, type, click, screenshot. Needs OS permissions; respect user stop.

cherryhq-cherry-studio-agents-cherry-ele.description: Develop, fix, profile, and test PRs in a tracked Cherry Studio Electron instance. Use for implementation, UI and interaction work, runtime debugging, DevTools inspection, performance analysis, and interactive PR verification with a test report. Reuse a verified workspace instance and manage its lifetime according to the selected workflow.

cherryhq-cherry-studio-agents-cherry-reg.description: Run Cherry Studio critical-path system regression tasks through the repository-owned Playwright E2E workflow. Use for full regression, release acceptance, development-branch system validation, or a named cherry-regression-test task on GitHub-hosted macOS and Windows runners.

cherryhq-cherry-studio-resources-builtin.description: 用户要求搜索、安装、查看或卸载 Skill，或内置能力不足时使用：先 search_skills，再 install_skill；无结果用 skill-creator 创建。
Use when Cherry Studio 用户希望报告、提交或整理 BUG、UI/UX 问题或功能建议，但未明确要求创建 GitHub Issue。

cherryhq-cherry-studio-resources-cherry-.description: Cherry tool routing: bun, uv, rg, knowledge, memory, schedules, skills, MCP, web. Read before shell workarounds.

cherryhq-cherry-studio-resources-builtin.description: Recommend Claude Code automations (hooks, subagents, skills, plugins, MCP) and review an existing setup.

cherryhq-cherry-studio-resources-code-cl.description: Run Antigravity CLI non-interactively for coding tasks. Use when the user asks to delegate work to Antigravity.
Run Claude Code non-interactively for coding tasks. Use when the user asks to delegate work to Claude Code.
Run Codex CLI non-interactively for coding tasks. Use when the user asks to delegate work to Codex.
Run DeepSeek Harness non-interactively for coding tasks. Use when the user asks to delegate work to it.
Run Gemini CLI non-interactively for coding tasks. Use when the user asks to delegate work to Gemini.
Run GitHub Copilot CLI non-interactively for coding tasks. Use when the user asks to delegate work to Copilot.
Run Hermes Agent non-interactively for local coding tasks. Use when the user asks to delegate work to Hermes.
Run Kimi Code non-interactively for coding tasks. Use when the user asks to delegate work to Kimi Code.
Run MiniMax Code non-interactively for coding tasks. Use when the user asks to delegate work to MiniMax Code.
Run the local OpenClaw agent non-interactively. Use when the user asks to delegate a bounded task to OpenClaw.
Run OpenCode non-interactively for coding tasks. Use when the user asks to delegate work to OpenCode.
Run Pi non-interactively for repository tasks. Use when the user asks to delegate analysis or implementation to Pi.
Run the Qoder CLI non-interactively with structured output. Use when the user asks to delegate a coding task to Qoder.
Run Qwen Code non-interactively for coding tasks. Use when the user asks to delegate work to Qwen Code.

cherryhq-cherry-studio-agents-create-ski.description: Create a new skill in the current repository. Use when the user wants to create/add a new skill, or mentions creating a skill from scratch. This skill follows the workflow defined in .agents/skills/README.md and helps scaffold, validate, and sync new skills.

cherryhq-cherry-studio-agents-docs-gover.description: Use when writing, restructuring, auditing, or reviewing Cherry Studio repository documentation, READMEs, JSDoc, comments, Agent instructions, or paired English/Chinese docs, including source-linked documentation impact checks.

cherryhq-cherry-studio-resources-builtin.description: 将成功解决的用户问题收录到 FAQ 知识库。问题解决后自动判断是否收录。也可以在用户说"收录到 FAQ"、"记录这个问题"、"add to FAQ"时手动触发。

cherryhq-cherry-studio-agents-find-simpl.description: Use when asked to find or plan Cherry Studio cleanup, simplification, refactoring, dead-code removal, duplicated state removal, unnecessary APIs, speculative generality, or library replacements, especially when the result should become evidence-backed proposed Agent Notes.

cherryhq-cherry-studio-resources-find-sk.description: Find and install agent skills when the user asks for a capability that may already exist as a skill.

cherryhq-cherry-studio-agents-gh-create-.description: Use when user wants to create a GitHub issue for the current repository. Must read and follow the repository's issue template format.

Create or update GitHub pull requests using the repository-required workflow and template compliance. Use when asked to create/open/update a PR so the assistant reads `.github/pull_request_template.md`, fills every template section, preserves markdown structure exactly, and marks missing data as N/A or None instead of skipping sections.

cherryhq-cherry-studio-agents-gh-pr-revi.description: Automated Cherry Studio review for local branches, PRs, commits, files, architecture docs, and repository skills. Use for code or documentation reviews that need project-specific naming, main/renderer/shared placement and dependency rules, IpcApi and DataApi boundaries, lifecycle/service ownership, renderer hooks, React/UI conventions, and tests. Review depth adapts to diff size and runtime subagent capability (single-agent or multi-agent reviewer-verifier). Report-only by default; code fixes and GitHub submission each require explicit invocation-time authorization (`fix` / `submit`).…

cherryhq-cherry-studio-agents-gh-stack.description: Manage Cherry Studio stacked branches and pull requests with the GitHub gh-stack extension. Use for planning, creating, inspecting, rebasing, syncing, linking, or recovering a stack of dependent PRs.
cherryhq-cherry-studio-agents-gh-stack.author: github

cherryhq-cherry-studio-resources-builtin.description: 仅在用户点名 GitHub Issue、Bug Report 或 Feature Request 时使用；未点名 GitHub 的反馈改用 cherry-studio-feedback。

cherryhq-cherry-studio-resources-office-.description: Extract or edit a selection from xlsx, docx, pdf, or pptx into a new file; the source is never modified.

cherryhq-cherry-studio-agents-prepare-re.description: Prepare a new release by collecting commits, generating bilingual release notes, updating version files, and creating a release branch. Use when asked to prepare/create a release, bump version, or run `/prepare-release`.

cherryhq-cherry-studio-resources-skill-c.description: Create, edit, evaluate, and optimize skills, including benchmarking and description tuning for better triggering.

cherryhq-cherry-studio-resources-builtin.description: 搜索、安装或创建 Agent Skill；用户说“find a skill”“搜索技能”“帮我做个 skill”或想扩展能力时使用。

cherryhq-cherry-studio-agents-translate-.description: Use when explicitly asked to translate, backfill, reconcile, rename, or delete paired Cherry Studio repository documentation in English and Simplified Chinese, including Phase 3 domain-by-domain translation work.

cherryhq-cherry-studio-agents-vercel-rea.description: React and Next.js performance optimization guidelines from Vercel Engineering. This skill should be used when writing, reviewing, or refactoring React/Next.js code to ensure optimal performance patterns. Triggers on tasks involving React components, Next.js pages, data fetching, bundle optimization, or performance improvements.
